label: Current roster observation at observed_at. These rows are not a historical lineup, a past transaction, or a next-week projection.
avg_basis_note: avg_fantasy_points is ESPN appliedAverage on the season-total split (stat id prefix 00), rounded to 2 decimals by the installed client, at observed_at. On the payloads checked for this client, appliedAverage equals appliedTotal divided by GP on that same split. GP is games that player has played, not team games and not fantasy matchup periods. games_played is that GP when the split includes it. The value is not points scored in the current matchup period.
acquisition_note: acquisition_status is ESPN acquisitionType when that field is present. free_agent means ESPN returned the player on the free-agent list at capture. Waiver priority is not a separate field on the installed client and is not inferred. Being on that list does not mean the player can be added immediately.
injury_note: injury_status is ESPN injuryStatus at observed_at. It describes the current observation, not the player's status during the games in the average.
